displayName: Build an onboarding plan for a new hire
summary: Create a structured onboarding doc with tools, workflows, and learning materials.

useCases.title: Build an onboarding plan for a new hire
useCases.message: Help me build an onboarding plan for a new hire. Ask me about the role, team, and start date. You might want to check what you already know about our tools and workflows before drafting. Then put together a structured plan covering their first 30, 60, and 90 days, with links to key resources and a checklist for day one.
